sanskrit_verse: दत्त्वा तु सोदयम् ऋणम् ऋणी दास्यात् प्रमुच्यते। कृतकालाभ्युपगमात् कृतकोऽपि विमुच्यते॥
transliteration: dattvā tu sodayam ṛṇaṃ ṛṇī dāsyāt pramucyate | kṛtakālābhyupagamāt kṛtako 'pi vimucyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the debtor pays the principal along with interest, the creditor is released from debt. Even a constructed obligation is dissolved upon acceptance of timely fulfillment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through conscious completion of relational obligations
Causation is resolved through voluntary restitution aligned with time-bound dharma
Capacity-based responsibility is fulfilled by honoring contractual or karmic alignment
Restoration occurs when both parties acknowledge completion within dharma-time
Consciousness alignment is achieved through mutual recognition of settled obligations
executable_legal_axioms: IF debtor offers full repayment INCLUDING accrued interest THEN creditor's claim SHALL be nullified
IF party acknowledges receipt of due compensation THEN all constructed liabilities SHALL dissolve automatically
IF time-bound obligation is met WITHIN agreed dharma-time THEN no residual liability SHALL persist
IF both parties confirm settlement THROUGH conscious assent THEN legal record SHALL reflect completion status
IF restitution aligns with causal sequence THEN punitive memory SHALL NOT be retained in system records
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that debts or obligations—whether natural or artificially constructed—are dissolved upon voluntary and complete fulfillment recognized by both parties. The court must ensure acknowledgment of payment or performance, not merely procedural compliance, to declare resolution. This reflects SPH-taught Nyaya where restoration supersedes punitive enforcement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that once repayment is made according to dharma-time, the cause for obligation ceases. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows the sequential unfolding from debt inception to its lawful dissolution. Proportional responsibility ends when proportional repayment occurs. Non-punitive reality rule holds that no further consequence attaches beyond completion; thus, justice is inherently restorative.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion verification process between debtor and creditor
Establish dharma-time window for voluntary restitution fulfillment
Record mutual acknowledgment of settlement in unified consciousness ledger
Dissolve artificial liability constructs upon confirmed restitution
Reintegrate involved parties into dharmic flow without residual burden
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: Debt dissolves through conscious completion. Dharma prevails through restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
